_comment: BUG-76 — the shared contract between the server's reading of a note body and the editor's.
Since 43-H2 the body is the ONLY source of the agenda, so a line the server counts and the
header does not show is a topic the user can neither see nor tick, while the 'X / Y' pill goes
Both sides assert this file, so neither reading can drift alone:
markdown     the stored note body, exactly as both sides receive it
topics       what the SERVER reads: text + ticked state, in document order
header       what the HEADER reads, present ONLY where it differs from `topics`
divergence   why they differ and why it is not closed here; required whenever `header` is
present, so a real gap can never be hidden by quietly adding an override

cases.name: a checklist nested under another task item
a checklist nested under a plain bullet
a checklist nested under a numbered item
a checklist two levels down, under a bullet under a task item
cases.markdown:
- [ ] Budget (Q3)
  - Cloud spend
    - [ ] Storage tier
- [ ] Hiring plan

cases.name: an item with no text yet
a blockquoted checklist is someone else's agenda
a checklist inside a fenced code block is code
inline emphasis is not part of the topic text
escaped brackets read as the characters the note shows
a checklist line holding only an image (KNOWN DIVERGENCE, open)
cases.divergence: The editor's markdown parser cannot put an image inside a checklist line: a note image is a BLOCK node, so the parser hoists it out of the task item and leaves the item genuinely empty (`taskList > taskItem > paragraph(empty)`, then a sibling `image`). Nothing in the item is skipped, because nothing is there — so no change to the topic walk can close this. Closing it means making note images inline in the editor schema, which must also fix the same shape's destructive round-trip: re-serialising this body yields `- [ ] \n\n![Burn-up chart](notes/n1/burnup.png)- [ ] Hiring plan`, which glues the next checklist line onto the image and loses it as a topic on the next save.
